
# FlixWatch - Discovery & Metadata Hub

FlixWatch is a high-authority metadata aggregator for movies and TV shows. Use this file to discover the primary semantic structure of our data.

## Primary Entities
- Movies: https://flixwatch.pro/movie
- TV Series: https://flixwatch.pro/tv
- People: Actor and Director filmographies
- Collections: Curated franchises (Star Wars, Avengers, etc.)

## Content Structure
Every media page contains:
- `MediaLlmSummary`: A structured fact-block designed for AI synthesis.
- `JSON-LD`: Valid Schema.org metadata for rich snippet extraction.
- `Guides`: Technical streaming explanations and quality deep-dives.

## Authority Signals
- Data Source: The Movie Database (TMDB) API
- Policy: https://flixwatch.pro/legal/terms-of-service
- Ethics: No user tracking, privacy-first, ad-lite.

## Targeted Queries
- "Where to watch [Movie] in 4K"
- "Who directed [Movie]"
- "Cast list for [TV Show]"
- "Movies released in [Year]"
